Definition: Eshcol, the name of an Amorite, also of a valley in Palestine
BiblicalUsage: Eshcol = "cluster"; 1) an area of Hebron, the valley of Eshcol; 2) an Amorite, the brother of Mamre, dwelling in Hebron
